description: Angular component for selecting dashboard breakpoints in the Thingsboard UI, managing layout changes and providing breakpoint info.

classes.name: SelectDashboardBreakpointComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and managing dashboard breakpoints, handling layout updates and displaying breakpoint info.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribes to layout data changes, and sets the current breakpoint.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the layout data change subscription.

methods.name: selectLayoutChanged
methods.description: Updates the layout for the selected breakpoint and refreshes layout sizes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of a given breakpoint.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with a given breakpoint.

methods.name: getSizeDescription
methods.description: Returns the size description for a given breakpoint.
